targets.query: from(bucket: "your-bucket") |> range($range) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "packets" and r._field == "packet_size")

from(bucket: "your-bucket") |> range($range) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "tcp_flags") |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey:["_field"], valueColumn:"_value") |> map(fn:(r) => ({ r with syn_ack_ratio: if r.ack == 0 then r.syn else r.syn / r.ack }))
